text:
micah: Heads-up — prepping catalog launch for Tue. Need final signoff on 3 open models: ozark-3b, marlin-7b-lite, fenrir-6b. Licensing + perf profiles still outstanding. Who's owning what?
elaine: I own ozark-3b. Legal flagged an SPDX/dep attribution gap, pinging upstream now. Perf team — can you prioritize a 1k-sample latency profile?
raj: I can take marlin-7b-lite perf. I scheduled a quantized run in staging tonight. Metadata PR #4523 contains the manifest. @carmen can you confirm license?
carmen: Confirmed marlin is Apache-2.0, we just need the attribution block in the manifest. I'll open a small PR to add it. ETA EOD.
sophie: Fenrir-6b has embedding shape mismatch with our embeddings pipeline (model -> 1536, we expect 1024). Working on a shim to project -> will post script.
micah: For rollout policy — propose canary -> 50% -> 100%. Thoughts?
raj: I'd prefer canary 10% for 6h then 50% for 24h. Gives time for latency/error signals without big user impact.
elaine: +1 to raj's slow ramp.
carmen: Legal cleared ozark and marlin. Fenrir has a third-party model-card requirement — I'll attach the template to the checklist.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2025-11-05T23:00:00Z (job: model-catalog-staging).
micah: CR ping: @sophie can you review metadata PR #4523 (marlin manifest + runtime hints)? small schema changes only.
sophie: On it, will review in ~2h.
micah: Blocking: CI tokenizer test failing for fenrir. Error looks like token counts off by 1 on some lines. @raj can you take a look?
raj: Taking it. Quick suspicion: unicode normalization differences. Temporary fix: set `normalize_unicode=True` in tokenizer config and re-run. Example patch: ```python
# tokenizer config
config = {"model": "fenrir-6b", "normalize_unicode": True, "add_bos": False}
```
micah: Nice — if that passes, we can retest embeddings.
elaine: I've updated the catalog sheet: owners/ozark-3b = elaine, owners/marlin-7b-lite = raj, owners/fenrir-6b = sophie. Added licensing links.
sophie: Added the projection script to gist and a short usage note. Also included a small test harness: `python convert_embed.py --input sample.json --out sample1024.json`.
raj: Staging perf dashboard: https://perf.redwood/internal/dashboards/staging-models?job=marlin (I uploaded the 1k-sample run).
micah: OK — target launch Tue 16:00 UTC. If legal docs aren't merged by Mon EOD, we hold. Owners, please update the checklist row when your PRs land.
carmen: Will do. :thumbsup:
elaine: One more ask — can we ensure the latency SLO column on the catalog matches the runtimes? I'll add ozark numbers tomorrow morning.
micah: Thanks all. If anyone needs pairing time, I'm free 10-11am PST tomorrow.
